scripts.dsh: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; DSH_HOME=$PWD/runtime/dsh-home dsh web --patch runtime/patch.web.yml
scripts.dsh:dump: set -a; [ -f .env ] && . ./.env; set +a; DSH_HOME=$PWD/runtime/dsh-home dsh web --patch runtime/patch.web.yml --dump-config
scripts.dev: concurrently -n dsh,bff,web -c blue,green,yellow "pnpm run dsh" "pnpm run dev:bff" "pnpm run dev:web"
